credits.title: Credits
credits.disclaimer: Drake is unofficial open source software. Not affiliated with Riot Games.

autoAccept.title: Auto Accept
autoAccept.subtitle: Accepts the ready check for you the moment it appears.
autoAccept.delayHelp: A short wait leaves you a window to decline by hand, and looks less mechanical than accepting the instant the prompt renders.

status.title: Status Message
status.subtitle: Your chat presence. Line breaks work here — the client's own field is a single-line input and cannot hold them.
status.presenceHelp: Drake keeps re-applying the chosen status whenever the client resets it.
status.placeholder: Type or paste your status. ASCII art welcome.

queue.title: Queue
queue.subtitle: Tools for champ select.
queue.revealHelp: Looks your whole team up on a scouting site. Only works while you are in champ select, because that is when the names exist.
queue.inClientHelp: Rewrites ally rows and enables the Ctrl+Shift+D cards overlay while in champ select.
queue.currentQueueWarn: Current queue can look sparse if that player rarely plays this queue.
queue.concurrencyWarn: Higher concurrency loads the client harder and can hit rate limits.
queue.estimate: About ~{seconds}s for a full lobby at this setting.

recommend.one: Based on your last reveal, we suggest resolving {count} player at a time.
recommend.other: Based on your last reveal, we suggest resolving {count} players at a time.

queue.optionsDisabled: Enable in-client reveal to change these.
queue.dodgeHelp: Leaves champ select. Costs you the usual dodge penalty — Drake does not confirm first, so only press it if you mean it.
queue.dodgeToggle: Show dodge button in champ select
queue.dodgeToggleHelp: Places a Dodge button over the client while you are in champ select.
queue.mapSide: Show map side in champ select
queue.autoMessagePlaceholder: Message to send when chat connects...

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How Drake itself behaves.
settings.runAtStartupHelp: Keeps the client injected before it launches, so this panel is always available.
settings.autoReload: Reload the client when Drake starts
settings.autoReloadHelp: Only used when Drake finds the client already running without Drake loaded.
settings.autoUpdateHelp: Downloads the latest GitHub release and runs the installer. Windows will ask for permission because Drake lives in Program Files.
settings.analytics: Share anonymous usage stats and error reports
settings.analyticsHelp: Sends an anonymous install ID, the Drake version, your League server region, session start/stop and error reports, so we know how many people use Drake and can fix what breaks. No summoner name, account or match data.
settings.noInstaller: {version} is on GitHub but has no Windows installer yet.
settings.alreadyCurrent: Drake is already up to date
settings.unlockStatusHelp: Removes the client's 25-character cap on your own status message and gives the field room to breathe. Takes effect on the next client reload.
settings.clientHelp: Reloads the League client UI. Use this when Drake injected while the client was already open, or after a change that only applies on a reload.
settings.languageHelp: Drake follows the League client language by default. Pick a language here to always use it instead.
settings.streamingAuto: Auto (when a streaming app is open)
settings.streamingHelp: Moves Drake into a separate window that OBS, Streamlabs and Discord cannot capture, so your stream never shows it. Team reveal stays off while that window is in use.
settings.streamingDragHelp: In the overlay, drag the Drake and Dodge buttons to wherever you like.

autoPick.title: Auto Pick
autoPick.subtitle: Up to 2 champions per role. Picks wait until your lane is assigned — Fill does nothing.
autoPick.instaLockHelp: Locks the champion in the instant the pick opens, instead of only hovering it. Nobody can take it from you, and you cannot change your mind.
autoPick.empty: Click up to 2 champions for this role — first is your pick, second is the backup.

autoBan.title: Auto Ban
autoBan.subtitle: Bans a champion for you when the ban phase reaches your turn.
autoBan.toggleHelp: A ban is always locked in — hovering a ban bans nothing.
autoBan.empty: Click a champion to ban — click again or ✕ to clear.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: What other players see. None of this changes your account.
profile.rankHelp: Shown next to your name in chat. Your real rank is unchanged.
profile.badgesHelp: The three tokens on your profile. Clone copies the first into all three slots.
profile.riotHelp: Renaming is rate-limited by Riot, not by Drake. If it refuses, that is their cooldown talking.

friends.title: Friends
friends.empty: Nobody on the list, or the client has not shared it yet.
friends.summary: {online} online of {total}. Notes are the ones you set in the client.
friends.warning: Removing everyone cannot be undone from Drake.

confirm.one: This removes {count} friend. It cannot be undone from Drake.
confirm.other: This removes all {count} friends. It cannot be undone from Drake.

whatsNew.title: What's New
whatsNew.subtitle: Changes in v{version}
whatsNew.missedTitle: Also new since your last update

champions.unavailable: Champion list unavailable — reopen this screen to try again.

mandatoryUpdate.title: Update required
mandatoryUpdate.body: Drake {version} is a required update. Install it to keep using Drake.
mandatoryUpdate.note: Until you update, Drake stays off in the client. League itself keeps working.
mandatoryUpdate.failed: The update could not be installed: {reason}
mandatoryUpdate.restarting: Drake is restarting with the new version…
mandatoryUpdate.cancelled: The update was not installed. If Windows asks for permission, choose Yes and try again.
mandatoryUpdate.timeout: Drake did not come back after the update. Open Drake again from the Start menu, then reload the client.

v0_4_5.title: Smoother required updates
v0_4_5.body: After you click Update now, Drake shows each step, restarts with the new version and reloads the client for you. If the update does not finish, it tells you why and lets you try again.

v0_4_5.title: Credits links open again
v0_4_5.body: The links on the Credits page open in your browser again.

v0_4_4.title: Catch up on what you missed
v0_4_4.body: If you skip an update, What's New now also lists the versions you missed, with the important changes spelled out. Otherwise it shows the last few releases.

v0_4_3.title: Smoother start inside other loaders
v0_4_3.body: Drake no longer reports a temporary error while it prepares the plugins folder of another loader, such as SkLoL.

v0_4_2.title: Drake works inside SkLoL
v0_4_2.body: Drake now loads inside SkLoL and other Pengu-based loaders that keep their plugins in their own folder, and shows the loader's real name. If the loader needs administrator rights, Drake asks once.

v0_4_2.title: Required updates
v0_4_2.body: When an update is required, Drake tells you right in the client and pauses until you install it. League keeps working in the meantime.

v0_4_1.title: Drake speaks more languages
v0_4_1.body: Spanish, Turkish, Russian and Swedish join English and Brazilian Portuguese. Drake follows the League client language, and Swedish can be picked in Settings.

v0_4_0.title: A brand-new Drake
v0_4_0.body: Every screen was rebuilt with a refined hextech look, smoother animations and clearer layouts — the panel, Team Scouting, the Build tab, the champ select docks and the social bar button.

v0_4_0.title: Drake speaks your language
v0_4_0.body: Drake follows the League client language by default, and you can pick another one in Settings. English and Brazilian Portuguese are fully translated; other languages fall back to English for now.

v0_4_0.title: Streaming mode
v0_4_0.body: Turn it on (or leave it on Auto) in Settings and Drake moves into its own window that OBS, Streamlabs and Discord cannot capture — you still see everything, your stream sees nothing. Team reveal stays off while it is active.

v0_4_0.title: Quitting Drake really turns it off
v0_4_0.body: Quit in the tray now removes Drake from the League client and reloads it clean, so nothing keeps loading after Drake is closed. Open Drake again and it switches itself back on.

v0_4_0.title: Anonymous usage stats
v0_4_0.body: Drake now counts how many people use it: an anonymous install ID, the Drake version and your League server region. No summoner name, account or match data. You can turn it off under Settings → Updates.

v0_3_25.title: Lobby reveal regions fixed
v0_3_25.body: External lobby reveal (Porofessor / OP.GG) now maps Riot platform ids correctly — e.g. LA2 → las — and OP.GG uses the current /lol/multisearch URL. Reported by Julio Maggioni.

v0_3_24.title: Dropdowns actually work now
v0_3_24.body: Rank, Region, and every other dropdown in Drake (Queue settings, Profile) responded to clicks unreliably or not at all for some users — replaced with a dropdown Drake fully controls, so picking an option always sticks.

v0_3_24.title: Fixed Recent W/L, KDA, and Last 12h showing 0
v0_3_24.body: A queue-detection bug could zero out a teammate’s recent stats in Team Reveal. Fixed at the source.

v0_3_24.title: Build Panel, redesigned
v0_3_24.body: If you missed it: champ select builds from OP.GG — runes, items by phase, skill order, matchups, and top players — now laid out closer to what you’d see on Mobalytics, with one-click Apply actions and Create Item Set. Open it from Ctrl+Shift+D.

v0_3_23.title: Team reveal match history via tray proxy
v0_3_23.body: Champ select scouting fetches recent games through the Drake tray proxy so W/L and Last 5 load reliably alongside names and ranks.

v0_3_23.title: Match loading skeletons
v0_3_23.body: Opening Team Scouting while matches are still loading shows skeletons instead of empty 0W/0L placeholders.

v0_3_22.title: Build panel
v0_3_22.body: Champ select builds from OP.GG: runes, items, skill order, summoner spells, matchups, and top players — with Apply actions and Create Item Set.

v0_3_22.title: Tighter build layout
v0_3_22.body: Summoner Spells sit under Skill Order so the right column fills and you scroll less to see the full loadout.

v0_3_21.title: Chat reveal waits for connect
v0_3_21.body: Team reveal keeps retrying until champ select chat connects, then posts the name map and rewrites authors.

v0_3_20.title: Reveal names in champ select chat
v0_3_20.body: Team reveal posts a private name map in chat and rewrites message authors to Riot IDs while you are in champ select.

v0_3_20.title: Credits
v0_3_20.body: A ? next to Close opens credits for Drake and the tools that inspired it.

v0_3_20.title: Fresh lobby W/L each queue
v0_3_20.body: Match history is fetched without HTTP cache so your W/L updates after the last game.

v0_3_20.title: Update prompt when auto-update is off
v0_3_20.body: Starting Drake asks whether to install a newer release if automatic updates are disabled.

v0_3_19.title: Reveal follows swaps with you
v0_3_19.body: In-client team reveal remaps names when you trade cells with an ally, including when their identity is still obfuscated.

v0_3_19.title: Auto Ban clear control
v0_3_19.body: Selected ban shows as a chip with icon and ✕ — no need to search the champion again to deselect.

v0_3_19.title: Cancel Queue leaves search
v0_3_19.body: Cancel Queue declines the ready check and also exits matchmaking search so you are fully out of queue.

v0_3_18.title: Auto Pick by role
v0_3_18.body: Choose up to 2 champions for Top, Jungle, Mid, ADC, and Support. Picks wait until your role is assigned — old global picks were cleared.

v0_3_18.title: Lobby reveal resets between games
v0_3_18.body: Ally names from the last lobby no longer stick when you queue again; scrub only rewrites rows that still show our reveal.

v0_3_17.title: Welcome tour
v0_3_17.body: First open shows a short welcome with an optional spotlight tour of the Ctrl+D screens. Skip anytime.

v0_3_17.title: What's New
v0_3_17.body: After an update, Ctrl+D opens a changelog. Reopen it anytime from the sidebar; feature rows jump to that screen.

v0_3_17.title: Reveal follows role swaps
v0_3_17.body: In-client team reveal remaps names when players trade cells in champ select.

v0_3_17.title: Ranked pool controls
v0_3_17.body: Choose Solo+Flex, current queue, or any queue for recent games, plus sample size, last-5 pool, and fetch concurrency.

v0_3_16.title: Pick WR on cards
v0_3_16.body: Reveal cards show games and win rate for the champion they locked.

v0_3_16.title: Champ select dodge
v0_3_16.body: Optional in-client dodge button (on by default) from Queue settings.

welcome.copy: Tools that sit beside the client. A short tour covers the screens you will use most.

steps.body: Set a long status message and lock Online, Offline, Mobile, or Busy.
